title: Python reference version_is_newer diverges from RFC 6550 section 7.2; disagrees with Rust lollipop_cmp
description: python/src/lichen/rpl/dodag.py version_is_newer (lines 43-65): linear-linear uses plain new>old with NO SEQUENCE_WINDOW (e.g. 120 vs 5 called newer; Rust: incomparable per RFC rule 3.2.2); circular-circular uses 0<diff<128 half-window instead of |diff|<=16 (RFC rules 3.2.1/3.2.2, SEQUENCE_WINDOW=16); cross-region returns 'linear always newer' unconditionally, while RFC rule 3.1 says the unwrapped side wins unless wrap distance <=16. rust/lichen-rpl/src/dodag.rs lollipop_cmp matches RFC 6550 section 7.2 exactly (verified against RFC text incl. worked examples: 240 vs 5 -> older-side... i.e. 240 newer than 5; 250 vs 5 -> 5 newer). AGENTS.md requires all implementations produce identical output for test vectors - Python must be aligned or the divergence documented with its own vectors.
